name: check-panic-expression-operator-test-baa47123b9/checkpanic-semantic-e
reason: The checking-expr support covers checkpanic. This negative semantic case exercises checkpanic on non-error operands and assignment of its remaining string|int result to string, alongside a valid string|MyError|CustomError operand. These are checking-expression and ordinary type-checking behaviors within the supported grammar and type system; the custom error constructors and type definitions introduce no unsupported feature.
test_design_notes: The source marks expected compile-time errors with @error, including two on one line. It has no @args, @panic, or @output assertions and does not assert runtime panic behavior.
